def f(I):
    I=[r[:] for r in I]
    # find horizontal separator line
    for i in range(len(I)):
        if len(set(I[i]))==1: sep=I[i][0]; si=i; break
    else:
        # vertical
        for j in range(len(I[0])):
            if len({I[i][j] for i in range(len(I))})==1:
                sep=I[0][j]; sj=j; break
    # split into two blocks on each side (skip any all-separator columns?) 
    blk1=[[I[i][j] for j in range(sj)] for i in range(si)]
    blk2=[[I[i][j] for j in range(sj+1,len(I[0]))] for i in range(si+1)]
    return [[2 if blk1[i][j]!=0 and blk2[i][j]!=0 else 0 for j in range(len(blk1[0]))] for i in range(min(len(blk1),len(blk2)))]
